## Introduction


```{r}
dau_basictiles <- readRDS("/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/dtu_basictiles_emseq_cancer_healthy.rds")
dmr_emseq <- readRDS("/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/dmr_emseq_strict.rds")
dmr_emseq <- dmr_emseq %>% .[order(.$min_smoothed_fdr),] %>% mutate(dmr_rank = 1:n())
```

```{r}
ct_markers <- read.table("/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/Markers.U250.hg38.tsv", header = FALSE)
```
```{r}
colnames(ct_markers) <- c("seqnames", "start",	"end",	"startCpG",	"endCpG",	"target",	"region",	"lenCpG",	"bp",	"tg_mean",	"bg_mean",	"delta_means",	"delta_quants",	"delta_maxmin",	"ttest",	"direction")
ct_markers
```

```{r}
marker_sigtile <- find_overlaps(as_granges(filter(dau_basictiles, FDR < 0.05)), as_granges(ct_markers)) %>% data.frame()
```

```{r}
marker_sigtile %>%
  group_by(region) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% .[order(.$n, decreasing = TRUE),]
```

```{r}
marker_sigtile %>% group_by(target) %>% summarise(n=n())
marker_sigtile %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = target, fill = target)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
marker_sigtile %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(seqnames, levels = seqs), fill = seqnames)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## props markers
```{r}
ranks <- marker_sigtile %>% distinct(dtu_rank) %>% .$dtu_rank
props_marker <- tile_prop("/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/emseq_healthy.parquet", "/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/emseq_all_cancer.parquet", 
          dau_basictiles[ranks,])
#props_marker <- props_marker[,c(1:14,16:24)]
props_marker <- props_marker %>%
  mutate(
    alpha_group = case_when(
      alpha < 0.2  ~ "a < 0.2",
      alpha > 0.8  ~ "a > 0.8",
      alpha <= 0.4 ~ "0.2 <= a <= 0.4",
      alpha < 0.6  ~ "0.4 < a < 0.6",
      TRUE         ~ "0.6 <= a <= 0.8"
    )
  ) %>% mutate(alpha_group = factor(alpha_group, levels = c("a < 0.2", "0.2 <= a <= 0.4", "0.4 < a < 0.6", "0.6 <= a <= 0.8", "a > 0.8"))) %>%
  count(type, dtu_rank, region_id, alpha_group, name = "tile_band_count") %>%
  group_by(region_id, dtu_rank, type) %>%
  mutate(prop_alpha_in_tile = tile_band_count / sum(tile_band_count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(region_id, dtu_rank, alpha_group, type, prop_alpha_in_tile) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = prop_alpha_in_tile) %>%
  mutate(prop_change = cancer - healthy)
```


## look at blood regions

```{r}
marker_sigtile %>% filter(grepl("Blood", target))
```

```{r}
rrbs_plot5("/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/emseq_healthy.parquet", "/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/emseq_all_cancer.parquet", "chr21", 45000001, 45000500) # + geom_beta(betas_all, plot.height = 0.5, style = "smooth") 
```
```{r}
props_marker %>% filter(dtu_rank == 2281) %>% mutate(alpha_group = factor(alpha_group, levels = c("a < 0.2", "0.2 <= a <= 0.4", "0.4 < a < 0.6", "0.6 <= a <= 0.8", "a > 0.8"))) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(cancer, healthy), names_to = "type", values_to = "percent") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = alpha_group, y = percent, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("cancer" = "#C0622A", "healthy" = "#1B3A6B")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Low", "Low-med", "Med", "Med-high", "High")) +
  labs(x = "alpha band") +
  facet_wrap(~region_id) +
  theme_bw()
```
